line_items.reasoning: Q4 revenue of $14.3B came in at the high end of the guided range of $13.3B–$14.3B, exceeding the midpoint of $13.8B by ~$500M.
Non-GAAP gross margin of 42.1% beat the guided ~39.5% by 260 basis points, aided by higher revenue, better costs, and the $1.1B CHIPS Act grant received in Q4.
Q4 non-GAAP EPS of $0.13 exceeded the guided $0.12, consistent with the revenue and margin outperformance.

No specific Q4 CapEx actuals were reported against the guided 2024 gross/net CapEx of ~$25B/$11B; the CHIPS Act grant receipt is a positive development but does not directly contradict the CapEx guidance.

The 2025 OpEx target of $17.5B and workforce reduction of >15% were reaffirmed with no reported deviation, and the CHIPS Act grant signing is a positive milestone, though 2025 free cash flow outlook remains uncertain given the sharp Q1 revenue guide-down.
